text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After several hours of waiting, Tosen
Jordan still
hasn't turned up for training.
Feeling a little
concerned, I go to look
for her, and...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Crap! I totally forgot. Soooo sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't get this new grape frappe
out of my
head. Hehehe... ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yikes. It didn't even cross my
mind how
long I kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be more careful from now
on—promise! How
about I get you a
snack or something as an
apology?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad everything is okay, but she
seems to be
slacking off, so I give her a
stern talking-to.
